name: Mashiro-iro Symphony: Sana Edition
original_name: ましろ色シンフォニー SANA EDITION
source:
Inui Sana is a young lady who can’t admit her feelings.

Luckily, she doesn’t have to at Yuihime Girls Private Academy, the place where she spends fun-filled days with her precious friends and the senior she loves.
Or at least, that’s how things have always been...

Now, her comfy and prestigious school is being merged with the boys’ school from the upstart side of town! Shoved into a combined class to trial the new system, she finds her world changing faster than she can keep up—and one of her new classmates makes her heart beat faster too. Quicker and quicker, the changes pile up, altering the landscape of her life like a sudden snowfall...

A new love story is about to begin.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2737980/Mashiroiro_Symphony_HD_Sana_Edition/]Steam[/url]]

The standalone game of [url=/c5103]Inui Sana[/url]'s route that was first included in the [url=/r11601]console edition[/url] of the Mashiro-iro Symphony. In addition, newly written scenes, new CGs, as well as H scenes are also added.
translation:
乾紗凪是個不肯坦率面對自己感情的女孩。

在私立結姬女子學園，她倒也用不著坦白。身邊有珍視的朋友，還有自己最喜歡的學姊，每一天都過得很開心。至少，以前一直如此……

可如今，她熟悉的這所名門女校，竟要和城市新興區域的一所男校合併！紗凪被編進試行合併的班級，身邊的一切快得讓她跟不上，而新同學中的某個人，也讓她的心越跳越快。變化一層層積起來，彷彿一場突如其來的雪，悄悄改變了生活的景色……

一段新的戀愛故事即將開始。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2737980/Mashiroiro_Symphony_HD_Sana_Edition/]Steam[/url]。]

本作將《純白交響曲》[url=/c5103]乾紗凪[/url]的個人路線獨立成篇。這條路線最初收錄於[url=/r11601]主機版[/url]，本作另外收錄全新撰寫的劇情、新繪製的CG及成人場景。
